correctness.rationale: The all-set trigger is proved both ways by explicit propagation from a full closed neighborhood; minimality follows from a contained size-2k trigger. Minimum multiplicities use separate complete, cocktail-party and long-cycle cases with unique run representation. The transfer-matrix coefficient identity follows from a bijection between weighted cyclic binary words and closed de Bruijn walks. The actual verifier checked 327512 subsets over 35 graph profiles and 30 additional minimum boundary profiles. Finite tests are corroborative, not universal proof.

evidence: Abiad et al. prove Z(C_n^k)=2k and show consecutive 2k vertices force, but do not classify all forcing subsets or their multiplicities; Brimkov–Carlson general well-forced criterion requires specific verification on the new graph family.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Broader scalar minimum and general structural conditions do not imply the new iff first-force rule or all coefficients without the graph-specific proof. Previously known scalar result excluded from priority claim.

evidence: Ordinary-cycle case k=1 and scalar Z=2k are explicitly prior. No inspected result asserts a first force suffices for all consecutive circulants, hence neither the matrix construction nor the count of all minimal sets is directly established there.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new claim has stronger quantifiers over k>=2 and over all vertex subsets, not simply a restatement or parameter substitution in the scalar minimum.

evidence: Cyclic power C_n^k is the consecutive circulant on steps 1..k; C_{2m}^2 is an alternative total-graph description for even m-compatible parameters. No directly equivalent full enumerator identified.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The combinatorial object and set counts were compared under graph aliases rather than relying on title matches. Searches have limited completeness.

evidence: Research-record searches returned related fan/friendship zero-forcing polynomials and prior tree results, not an exact cyclic-power coefficient table or general transfer formula.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: A failed search cannot prove absence; no exact matching database or coefficient table was evidenced in inspected sources.

originality.rationale: Boyer et al. establish the polynomial framework and k=1 cycles; Brimkov–Carlson and Grood et al. give general minimal/well-forced theory; Abiad et al. already prove the scalar Z=2k. None of the primary material read states the all-set first-force equivalence, full cyclic-power polynomial or exact multiplicity trichotomy. A transfer expression is not a priority claim about a new counting method; the main structural implication and its enumerative consequences are the claimed advance. Novelty risk remains from incompletely indexed consecutive-circulant research.
residual_risks: Equivalent coefficient enumerators under consecutive circulant or total-graph terminology may exist outside the inspected corpus.
A general symbolic method could implicitly yield the transfer matrix, though it would not alone establish the cyclic first-force rigidity.
